import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 32;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n;
    static long[][] mat = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] base = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][][] A = new long[MAXN][MAXN][];
    static long[][] pre = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] suf = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] ans = new long[MAXN][MAXN];

    static void initMat(long[][] m) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                m[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    static void addMod(long[] x, int y) {
        x[0] += y;
        if (x[0] >= MOD) x[0] -= MOD;
    }

    static long[][] matMul(long[][] a, long[][] b) {
        long[][] res = new long[n + 2][n + 2];
        initMat(res);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n + 1; k++) {
                    long val = (a[i][k] * b[k][j]) % MOD;
                    addMod(res[i], (int) val);
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        n = sc.nextInt();

        // Initialize base matrix
        initMat(base);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            base[i][i] = 1;
        }

        // Initialize answer as base
        for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(base[i], 0, ans[i], 0, n + 2);
        }

        // Initialize A[i]
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                System.arraycopy(base[j], 0, A[i][j], 0, n + 2);
            }
            A[i][i][i] = 1;
        }

        // Initialize pre and suf
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(base[i], 0, pre[i], 0, n + 2);
            System.arraycopy(base[i], 0, suf[i], 0, n + 2);
        }

        while (m != 0) {
            long u = m % n;
            if (u != 0) {
                long s = 0;
                for (long v = m; v != 0; v /= n) {
                    s = (s + v / n) % n;
                }
                u = (s + u - 1) % n + 1;
                for (; u != s; u--) {
                    if (u <= 0) u += n;
                    ans = matMul(A[(int) u], ans);
                }
            }
            // Update pre
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                pre[i] = matMul(pre[i - 1], A[i]);
            }
            // Update suf
            for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
                suf[i] = matMul(A[i], suf[i + 1]);
            }
            // Update A
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                A[i] = matMul(suf[i], pre[i - 1]);
            }
            m /= n;
        }

        int total = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            addMod(new long[]{total}, (int) ans[n + 1][i]);
            total = (int) new long[]{total}[0];
        }
        System.out.println(total);
        sc.close();
    }
}
